sentences.en: The contemporary innovation of learning, as an undividable aspect of social progression, has been the motive force of the development of society.

sentences.en: As a kind of psychosomatic disorder, primary dysmenorrhea has undividable connection with the mental problems, which actually is a kind of concrete and typical pain.

sentences.en: This article points out it and is composed of three basic undividable elements: exclusive ownership, common ownership. The article also analyzes the three elements to the law of real rights of China.

sentences.en: Chinese history of ornamental stones is quite long. Culture of ornamental stones is one undividable part of Chinese culture.
